source: Not copied from rbeaglemedia/event-space-planner. That private repo was not readable from this agent. Ids are the names Bob used. Swap the bakers for the real modules when access exists. Keep these ids.

save.garageZ: world/garagez.js still reads zdash.kid.v1 eq only. This catalog does not add a key and does not change the 370Z mesh.

api.parts: PLANNER_PROPS.parts(id, params) → local boxes in the prop frame, facing +z, y up. Proof code: test/planner-port/catalog.js
api.remix: PLANNER_PROPS.remix(id) → local boxes for a remix id
api.building: bakeBuilding(doc) → footprint boxes {x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1,part,color,glow}. placeOnBox(parts, cityBox, face) maps them with the same door-face frame as NOS_STATION in PR #76. Proof code: test/planner-port/bake.js

style.A: Daylight. White or cream, tan floor, glass, glow 0.
style.B: Same shell plus one cyan #3ee6ff strip. Interiors agent bc-80a1fc6f owns the room pick. Bob's house note is A plus that one strip.

props.anatomy: Face is 0.9 m tall. On a wall, keep the bottom at or above 1.05 m so the 0.74 m pet is not inside it. Ellie at 1.7 m sees the middle.
Seat 0.4 m, back 0.78 m. Below Ellie's shoulder. The pet walks past it, not onto the back.
Top at 0.75 m, just above the pet's 0.74 m head. Do not scale the top down through the pet.
Screen top is about 1.1 m, between the pet and Ellie's eyes.
0.9 m. Taller than the pet, shorter than Ellie.
A segment, not a room prop. Outdoor remixes stack it. Do not place a segment through the 1.7 m body.
Deck is about 0.7 m. Ellie can stand beside it. She does not ride in it. The screen is on the side, clear of her head.

remixes.where: The Stage curb, and a parked truck on a Builder Bay lot
The Stage, in front of the dance mural. Not a second building.
Highway shoulders that already have billboards. Cap 6 inside 170 m.
City kit arches: Car Row, The Stage, Builder Bay, The Track, The Field. No interior.
Idea only. Does not replace the river bridges.
Soccer shop interior, arcade prize counter, Builder HQ desk.
The Stage, flanking the mural. Not the sky tower.
City kit snack stall, about 12×10×5 m. The Stage uses the cafe instead.
